The Oxford takes its name from Oxford University — the style originated in Scotland and Ireland in the early 1800s and quickly caught on among university students. These lace-up dress shoes are clean, classic, and traditional. The “plain toe” refers quite literally to the clean, seamless toe box. It gives the shoe a simple, confident, restrained look that’s exceptionally versatile — plain-toe dress shoes are well-suited to work events and special occasions.
